title: A posting: the amount does not establish direction
goal: Create an original chart/register and reread amount and both sides of one synthetic entry.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P5. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: The register contains 100. Is that enough to call a training posting correct? Check amount, debit, credit, and recorder together.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Equality of sides is an invariant
paragraphs: The teaching model records 100 as a debit to one account and credit to another. Equal aggregate debits/credits do not prove correct account selection; operation meaning and analytics matter. This is not real accounting or tax advice; regulated rules are outside this synthetic example.

Create an actual chart of accounts named УчебныеСчета and an accounting register named УчебныеПроводки. Select that chart, enable correspondence and add balance resource Сумма: Number(15,2), recorded by ЗаявкаУслуги. This is not an array model. The screenshot in this lesson shows actual messages from the worked function; verify the metadata separately using the preparation steps.

paragraphs: Two distinct training accounts and one 100 posting are created for an own document. One result checks the amount; another checks the exact debit and credit references. The same amount with swapped accounts is a different claim.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Chart of accounts and register
paragraphs: The chart defines accounts and analytic settings; the accounting register stores movements. They are different objects. A full native exercise requires an original teaching chart/register, not a copied proprietary configuration. An array ofdebit/credit pairs teaches an invariant but does not execute an accounting register.

The function creates two own accounts with different codes and one 100-unit record for its own document. Units are educational, not enterprise accounting advice. A query rereads СчетДт/СчетКт/Сумма filtered by this recorder.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Debit and credit are swapped while the amount remains 250. Will the intended-direction check pass?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Direction is defined by the СчетДт / СчетКт roles. Having both references and the expected amount is insufficient; each reference must occupy the intended field.

sections.title: Analytics refine meaning
paragraphs: An account can have customer/service analytics under the model. Missing analytics can preserve overall equality while misallocating customers. Add two customers with equal amounts and verify identities. This distinguishes formal side equality from correct accounting meaning.

Amount 100 and both account references are separate checks. Balanced sides do not establish correct business account selection. This minimal example adds no subaccounts/extra analytics; those require their own explicit design and checks, not a statutory-accounting claim.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: This diagram checks the worked example; it does not depict money transfers. One row, amount100, and expected references in debit/credit roles must hold together. These are this training function’s assertions, not automatic grading of learner work.

flowchart.caption: Check the worked posting
paths: All three conditions are required; a matching amount cannot repair swapped accounts.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Comparing only the set of two accounts or the amount misses a swap. Compare the debit to the expected debit and the credit to the expected credit.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Reversal and repeats remain explainable
paragraphs: Post a synthetic operation, reconcile sides/recorder, repeat and reverse. Debit and credit effects must change consistently. Explicitly label evidence as a BSL model, a real register or theoretical analysis. An unavailable permitted stand does not turn the first into actual register execution.

A compilable 101 mutation fails the independent 100 expectation. Repeating/reversing own-recorder effects needs its own case and must preserve other sets. Never use a real bookkeeping base; retain own accounts/document and do not clear the register for appearance.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create another own account pair and two 250 postings under different own documents. Use the intended roles in the first and deliberately swap them in the second. Expect amount 250, correct directionДа, and acceptance of the reversed postingНет.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.
